name: TSMC Fab 18, Tainan
summary: TSMC's 5nm and 3nm GIGAFAB in the Southern Taiwan Science Park, Tainan, laid out in its 2022 description as eight phases that each have about 58,000 square metres of cleanroom. At a December 2022 ceremony TSMC reported that 3nm was in volume production at the fab with good yield, topped out phase 8, and put the fab's total investment at more than NT$1.86 trillion with over 11,300 direct jobs. A January 2026 Commercial Times report, citing supply-chain sources, said phases 1 to 8 were all running N5 and N3 close to full utilization and that cleanroom and facility work on a ninth phase had begun in late 2025.

location.address: 8, Beiyuan Rd. 2, Southern Taiwan Science Park, Tainan 745-093, Taiwan

metrics.note: Cleanroom of each of phases 1 to 8, about twice a standard logic fab.
Direct high-tech jobs; more than 23,500 construction jobs were also cited.

milestones.note: Reported at the 29 December 2022 ceremony; TSMC dates N3 high-volume production to 2022.

Supply-chain sources cited by the Commercial Times said cleanroom and facility work on phase 9 began in the fourth quarter of 2025; the same report says phase 9 might instead become an advanced packaging plant.

notes: Status is partly operating: the January 2026 report describes phases 1 to 8 as producing and phase 9 as being fitted out. No TSMC source from 2024 to 2026 describing the later phases was found; TSMC's GIGAFAB page only lists Fab 18 among its six GIGAFABs, so the phase 9 work rests on a press report citing unnamed industry sources. The facility registry lists an environmental-control registration for a ninth phase of Fab 18, while TSMC's cited sources describe eight phases. The new 3nm fabs TSMC announced in 2026 for its GIGAFAB cluster in the same park are kept in their own record; no source says whether phase 9 is one of them.
